name: Poisoner’s Fortitude
body:
Your exposure to poisons has increased your fortitude.

Prerequisite(s): Craft (alchemy) 5 ranks, 2nd-level Assassin

Benefit: Your save bonus against poison from the assassin class also applies to all other Fortitude saves you make. This bonus temporarily ceases to apply if you have not been exposed to a poison within 1 day per assassin level you possess.
